notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least nine tapped lands.
description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Extus triggers, returning Ardent Elementalist from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Mana Geyser, adding {R} for each tapped land your opponents control.
Cast Ardent Elementalist by paying its mana cost.
When Ardent Elementalist enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Ardent Elementalist trigger, returning Mana Geyser from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ardent Elementalist.
Repeat.

uses.name: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar
